findings.title: Utah County nonprofit to close Heber City food pantry; announces layoffs
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The reduction will eliminate approximately 200 household appointment slots each week
findings.summary: Community Action Services and Food Bank announced on Monday, Oct. 26, that its Heber City pantry will close in November 2026 and that its Provo pantry will reduce hours by seven per week, eliminating approximately 200 household appointment slots weekly. Fifteen staff layoffs were also reported. The publisher's timestamp precedes this hourly observation window, so this is a late-discovered high-value recall signal, not a claim that the announcement occurred during the window. The provider's website corroborates organizational financial strain but still lists current pantry hours; full effective dates and independent confirmation of the cuts remain for editorial verification.
findings.scope: Two local community pantry locations; direct Heber closure and Provo weekly access reduction
affected_groups: Heber City residents who depend on Community Action Services food pantry
Provo-area food-insecure households seeking pantry appointments
